main.description: A signed Open Badges 3.0 Verifiable Credential published to the subject's own atproto repository. Public by construction — see apps/native-rd/docs/research/atproto-evaluation.md for why only the Public visibility state may use this.

credential.description: The signed OB3 Verifiable Credential, serialized as JSON. Stored as a string rather than a nested object because the VC's own key names (notably '@context') are not expressible in a Lexicon object schema, and because a verifier must hash the exact bytes that were signed — re-serializing a parsed object would break the signature.

issuerDid.description: The credential issuer's DID, denormalized out of the credential for cheap indexing. A spec-compliant did:key here means the credential verifies independently of this record's location — see the spike README, question 4.

image.description: The baked badge PNG carrying the credential in its iTXt chunk. Optional; the credential field is authoritative.

createdAt.description: When this record was published, which is not when the badge was earned — the credential's own issuanceDate is authoritative for that.
